cd /opt/trading-bot/classic && sleep 3 && python3 -W ignore <<'PYEOF'
import json
r = json.load(open('runs.json'))
h = json.load(open('hand.json'))
print('ТВОИ КАНАЛЫ И СДЕЛКИ:\n')
for ch in h:
    s, tf = ch['sym'], ch['tf']
    if ch.get('deleted'): continue
    run = next((x for x in r if x['sym']==s and x['cfg'].get('tf')==tf), None)
    if run:
        trades = run.get('trades',[])
        print(f'{s} {tf:4s} -> прогон id {run["id"]:2d}')
        if trades:
            print(f'  Сделок: {len(trades)}')
            for t in trades:
                print(f'    {t.get("side","?")} в {t.get("t_in",0)//1000%10000} -> {t.get("t_out",0)//1000%10000} | net {t.get("net",0):+.2f}%')
        else:
            print(f'  Сделок нет (канал свежий)')
PYEOF
